map.本工具用于微加工（精度/热影响）评估的合法性校验，依据对应数据格式与语法规范实时: This tool performs validity checking for micro-machining (precision/heat-affected) assessment, inspecting and locating errors in real time per the corresponding data-format and syntax rules; runs locally in the browser; data is not uploaded.
map.目标加工精度，越小越精密: Target machining precision; smaller is more precise
map.热影响区宽度，越小越好: Heat-affected zone width; smaller is better
map.激光/精密加工自检：按加工精度、热影响区、切割速度评估质量等级: Laser/precision machining self-check: assess quality grade by precision, heat-affected zone and cutting speed
map.工艺优化：比较不同参数下的综合评分: Process optimization: compare composite scores under different parameters
map.合格判定：评分低于阈值提示粗加工/不合格: Pass/fail judgment: a score below the threshold suggests rough machining / failure
map.加工精度评分：≤2μm=100、≤5=85、≤10=70、≤20=50、否则 3: Precision score: ≤2μm=100, ≤5=85, ≤10=70, ≤20=50, else 30; HAZ score: ≤5μm=100, ≤10=85, ≤20=70, ≤50=50, else 30; efficiency score: speed≥200=100, ≥100=80, ≥50=60, else 40; composite = precision×0.4 + HAZ×0.35 + efficiency×0.25. ≥90 Grade A, ≥75 B, ≥60 C, ≥40 D, else E.
map.精度 5μm(85)、热影响区 15μm(70)、速度 100(80)：综合=8: Precision 5μm(85), HAZ 15μm(70), speed 100(80): composite = 85×0.4+70×0.35+80×0.25 = 34+24.5+20 = 78.5 → 79 → Grade B (precision). If precision drops to 20μm the composite falls to about 68 (Grade C, ordinary).
map.HAZ 过大会改变材料组织、影响疲劳与密封性能，对精密件危害大，故权重取 0.3: A large HAZ changes the material structure and affects fatigue and sealing performance, harming precision parts, so its weight is 0.35; precision has the highest weight, 0.4.
map.是内部快速自检的经验加权评分，非强制标准；正式验收须按对应加工工艺规范与检测报告: It is an in-house quick self-check empirical weighted score, not a mandatory standard; formal acceptance must follow the corresponding machining-process specification and inspection report.
map.加工精度和热影响区是微加工质量的核心指标: Precision and HAZ are the core quality indicators of micro-machining
map.激光功率过大会增大热影响区，需平衡精度与效率: Excessive laser power enlarges the HAZ; balance precision and efficiency
map.评估结果仅供参考，实际加工需结合材料特性调整: Results are for reference only; actual machining needs adjustment by material properties
map.微加工（精度/热影响）评估工具，输入加工精度、热影响区宽度、切割速度和激光功率，: Micro-machining (precision/heat-affected) assessment tool. Input machining precision, HAZ width, cutting speed and laser power to assess the micro-machining quality grade by composite score. Precision weight 40%, HAZ 35%, efficiency 25%; outputs grade A–E. For quality assessment of laser machining, micro/nano manufacturing and other precision processes.
map.量化各项指标对加工质量的影响: Quantify each indicator's impact on quality
